metadata.description: johnnyvizz's public Claude Code skills and mods.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel; made for savvy-flow, shows any subagents.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Mod: band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost, prompt cache countdown, git branch, model, effort and context; spend warnings and a compact-keeping-recent-turns button; notifies before the cache expires.

plugins.name: prompt-index
plugins.description: Mod: pane listing this session's prompts; click one to jump there, filter and step through matches, see which are on screen. /prompts or the footer button toggles it.
